title: Kashinawa language
description: Panoan language of western South America
extract: Kashinawa, or Hantxa Kuin, is an Indigenous American language of western South America which belongs to the Panoan language family. It is spoken by about 1,600 Kaxinawá in Peru, along the Curanja and the Purus Rivers, and in Brazil by 400 Kaxinawá in the state of Acre.
